info.title: Main - Floriday Customers API
info.description:
﻿Every endpoint requires at least the `role:app` scope and the header `X-Api-Key` populated with your given API-key. Most endpoints also require an additional scope which is listed in their descriptions.

- 🗝 [Authorization server (staging)](https://idm.staging.floriday.io/oauth2/ausmw6b47z1BnlHkw0h7/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- 🗝 [Authorization server (live)](https://idm.floriday.io/oauth2/aus3testdcf2vyfs70i7/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- 📚 [Documentation](https://developer.floriday.io/docs/welcome)
- ▶ [Coding screencast: getting started (NL)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fdqzP7_Y_s8)

---

_The current state of this version 2026v1 is **Main**._
* This version will be main after April 2026.
* This version will be deprecated after October 2026.
* This version will be removed after April 2027.

---

🔗 2025v2: [Customers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2025v2/swagger/index.html) | [Suppliers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/suppliers-api-2025v2/swagger/index.html)
🔗 2026v1: [Customers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2026v1/swagger/index.html) | [Suppliers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/suppliers-api-2026v1/swagger/index.html)
🔗 2026v2: [Customers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2026v2/swagger/index.html) | [Suppliers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/suppliers-api-2026v2/swagger/index.html)

post.summary: purchase-order:write - Creates a new purchase order.
post.description:
Creates a purchase order that can be processed in the Floriday purchase dashboard. Specify either a `SupplyLineId`, `TradeItemId` or `VbnCriteria` and Floriday will attempt to find matching supply lines.

**Note**
Only use this endpoint in case the supply lines of a supplier are incomplete *and* if your client's employees actively use the Floriday purchase dashboard. In other cases, it will be better to place orders using `CreateSalesOrder`.

post.summary: purchase-order:write - Creates a new purchase order as order request.
post.description:
Creates a purchase order as order request. The supplier must enable the feature for the customer.
The order request will be automatically accepted when the order matches a valid supply line.

get.description:
**Synchronization endpoint**
Fetches the succeeding modified records (including deleted records) based on `Limit` and the given `SequenceNumber`.

**Note**
The results are filtered based on your connected suppliers. Your data is up to date when your given `SequenceNumber` is equal to the received `MaximumSequenceNumber`.
The post filters are applied after fetching the trade items with the `syncLimit`. This can result in a syncResult with fewer records and a `maximumSequenceNumber` that is higher than the sequence found in the results.
